deploybot: PROD rolling deploy started for prod-usw2
- tag: v3.6.0
- commit: 7a1b2c3d9ef0
- rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (auto health checks)
- change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC
- runbook: https://go/internal/releases/3.6.0
- important checks: DB migration dry-run, prefix cache warmup, latency & error-rate SLOs

alice: ack. starting preflight checks on infra side. is the DB migration live or deferred?

carla: pre-migration dry-run succeeded on staging at 02:10. migration script: migrate-v4, no destructive ops detected. will tail the migration logs.

dana: note — model variant pinned to rvc-2.1 for this rollout to avoid regressions on few-shot tasks. release notes pushed to draft.

emily: oncall here. I'll be watching the release dashboard and group channel. setting an alert: errors > 1% for 5m or p99 latency > 200ms.

frank: rollback criteria are the same as runway: >1% errors sustained for 5m OR token-cost spike >50%. rollback command ready: `deploybot rollback --env=prod-usw2 --tag v3.6.0`

deploybot: rollout at 5% complete — smoke checks: PASS (latency: 58ms, errors: 0.02%). moving to 25%.

alice: nice, keep an eye on KV cache miss rate (can spike after prefix warmup).

carla: KV cache miss rate is stable. no elevated DB connections.

deploybot: rollout at 25% complete — health checks: PASS. metrics: latency 62ms p95, errors 0.03%. advancing to 50%.

emily: slow query alert just fired in prod-db (duration ~1.8s) but only 2 occurrences. watching.

frank: confirmed slow queries are from a non-critical analytics job; not related to this deploy. marking as WAIVED for rollout.

deploybot: rollout at 50% complete — health checks: PASS. beginning final batch to 100%.

deploybot: rollout 100% complete — SUCCESS.
- tag: v3.6.0
- commit: 7a1b2c3d9ef0
- duration: 18m
- post-deploy smoke: PASS
- release notes: https://go/internal/releases/3.6.0/notes

alice: congrats. running a quick canary-log grep for obvious errors.

carla: metrics look clean across all zones. no error spikes, latency within expected bounds. closing the rollout monitor.

dana: publishing release notes to the docs site and emailing stakeholders.

emily: oncall: no followups from infra, closing oncall watch. :thumbsup:

frank: great work. tagging the release in git and archiving the temporary rollout channel.

deploybot: This thread will be archived. If any regressions appear, use `deploybot rollback` or ping #incidents for post-deploy action.
